name: court-docket-monitor
title: Court Docket Monitor
description: Monitor public court dockets for new cases, motions and rulings by party or jurisdiction. Litigation intelligence without manual PACER trawling.

input.title: Input schema for Pry Court Docket Monitor
input.description: Monitor public court dockets for new cases, motions and rulings by party or jurisdiction. Litigation intelligence without manual PACER trawling.

urls.title: Target URLs
urls.description: One or more https:// URLs to process.

party_filter.title: Party name filter
party_filter.description: Only emit docket entries matching this party.

max_items.title: Max items (cost cap)
max_items.description: Hard cap on processed items for this run - keeps trial costs predictable. Billing stops when the cap or your spending limit is reached.

proxy_configuration.title: Proxy configuration
proxy_configuration.description: Apify proxy settings passed through to Pry's premium-proxy tier. Leave default to use the platform proxy automatically.
